swing_ideas.text: Three day balance failed to go lower on Friday. Looking for a move over 73 to get back into blue sky territory. This has been unfazed through the entire tariff turmoil. Stays on watch so long as higher lows are over 70.75.
Pressure cooker top building after a muted earnings move. Looking for breaks over 134.7 to get into the last lower high at 144.5. Beyond that the highs at 156.8 are in play.

Starting to break out on Friday. Looking for a move to continue into the 21.85 area as a range double measured move. From there the more attractive range is over the weekly lower high 21.85 into the scene of the crime at 23.3. Slower mover, so factor that into your trade plan.

S&P hourly chart – These are some of the nuances that I'll be looking for to achieve the pathing outlined in the daily chart. White is base case. Green is better than expected and reasonable. Red is divergent from the base case and not supported by underlying evidence.

Market internals – No red flags here that are overly indicative of stronger sellers stepping up at the exchange level. If there was a day to get followthrough, it should have been Wednesdays gap down on the GDP print. Bulls ran with it into the weeks end.

Market profile – Stronger sellers should have moved into the single prints on Wednesday, instead the market stopped right at the top. The market also had a spike Wednesday into Thursday. The unfilled gap suggests sellers couldn't even test the spike... Value clean higher.
